sloka: स पुच्छमुद्यम्य भुजङ्गकल्पं विनम्य पृष्ठं श्रवणे निकुञ्ज्य।विवृत्य वक्त्रं वडवामुखाभमापुप्लुवे व्योमनि चण्डवेगः ।। ६.७४.४९ ।।
transliteration: sa pucchamudyamya bhujaṅgakalpaṁ vinamya pṛṣṭhaṁ śravaṇe nikuñjya।vivṛtya vaktraṁ vaḍavāmukhābhamāpupluve vyomani caṇḍavegaḥ ।। 6.74.49 ।।

translations.english: Raising his tail which resembled a serpent, bending his back, and ears, opening his mouth wide expounded Hanuman sprang up at terrific speed.
